conversations: Hey you, hand over the scroll!
Bah! Copy Ninja Kakashi! No wonder the ghost brothers didn't stand a chance…..
Oh? Isn't this missing-nin Momochi Zabuza?
Back off! This guy is way more powerful!
Excuse me? Could you hand over that old man? Or our employer would be angry!
Be in bankai formation and protect Mr. Tazuna…
Zabuza, beat me first!
Thank you very much!  I've been looking for an opportunity to kill Zabuza.
This mask……You are a hunter-nin in Kirigakure…
You are great …...You know who I am!
(Judging from his body and voice, he should be not much older than Naruto but is already a hunter-nin. Looks like he is not a normal kid…)
Why! Who the heck is he……
Stupid brother …
Why did you kill all clansmen?!
Because I want to see to what extent I can tolerate, but I'm disappointed at this mediocre clan...
Measuring tolerance? You killed everyone just for this?
This is not the most important.
No kidding! ! !
Letting you imitating me-your brother, is also to measure your "tolerance" ……
I will spare your life for my own sake. You can activate Mangekyō Sharingan like me, but there is one condition! Kill the most intimate person!
It's of no value to kill you…...My stupid brother……To kill me, hate me and live like an ant……
Why are you always getting in the way…..(Sasuke blocks the strike with his body for Naruto)
Why are you doing this?
You idiot! Just action comes before the brain!
Don't die! (Naruto is breathless. A evil Chakra comes out )
Haku! I will never forgive you! I will kill you!
Your mist is almost gone. Only death awaits you in the future!
Only death in my future? Kakashi, how do you know!
Many people have died for your ambition. This is not what ninjas should do!
So what? I battle for my ideal. I will never change it! Never!
Cough...Zabuza……
Who said I would die in the future! Kakashi, you are wrong!
(This kid blocks the blow for Zabuza!! )
Well done, Haku! Seems like I picked up a good thing! He created such a good chance at the last moment! (Zabuza hits Kakashi from the back)
He is your friend! How could you let them tramp on his body!
Shut up, kid! Haku is dead!
Zabuza! Don't you feel anything about Haku? Wasn't he following you all the time?
In the ninja world, we either use others or are used! Like Gato uses me, I use Haku. We ninjas are nothing but tools.
Seriously? That guy liked you! And you takes him for nothing! He died for you! He lived without dream and ended up like a tool. That's cruel……
Stop, kid……Lend me the Kunai! Even if I shall go to hell, I'll take them together……(Zabuza starts crying hearing Naruto and looks at Gato and his man with hatred)
There you are! If we three separate in the following three days, don't easily trust each other!
Then what should we do?!
We must get a cipher. Anyone that gets the wrong cipher shall be deemed as an enemy.

Listen carefully! I only speak it once! When I ask about ninja song "Ninja's Chance", you shall answer:  The best time to sneak in is when the enemies are in riot. The most important thing about being a ninja is to seize the moment!
It's too long! I can't memorize at all….
How stupid! I memorize it all!
This is really our cipher?
Idiot! From now on, I will keep the scroll! $fb0735#playername#$, $2cc1ff fortify$ the ninja tool and boost your power! What we will confront next is not some rookie we dealt with before!
How do you know I'm fake?
I knew you were overhearing our conversation, so I took the ninja song as the cipher. Naruto won't be able to memorize such long words and you speak it all out, which means you are fake.
I see. Then let's fight! Come on!
Lee……Why are you here?
Me? I show up whenever you are in danger.
Thank you for saving me…
No thanks!
I will protect you even if it means costing my life…
You are awake! Sasuke!
Sakura ... Who has beaten you like this...
Sasuke... Your body...
Bah! The power is coming out from inside! He gave this to me…
sound ninja? You did this to Sakura! Now come and die!
Who the hell are you?
Good question! I am toad sage. Nice to meet you!
Horny sage! Teacher Ebisu was supposed to train us! Now you made him like this!
He stopped me from collecting materials……
Then who is gonna train us? Since you are the one that made teacher Ebisu like this, you should take his place and train us!
Now I'll teach you a ninjutsu that I'm good at. Whether you can master it or not is up to you!
Heehee……I never thought I could fight against you! I've already seen you die! My dear teacher…
Orochimaru…..I was my fault. I was too naïve to think that you would change.
How pathetic! The god of ninja loses to me because of the old age…..
Long time no see! Sarutobi!
Oh, you! Sarutobi, you get old….
Never thought that I would meet you two under this circumstance! Now please be sober-minded!
Now I'm going to kill you to correct my past mistakes!
It's too late…..
Orochimaru! Let me show you the jutsu that even you haven't seen! Secret Technique: Dead Demon Consuming Seal!
Iruka sensei, let's go! The 3rd Hokage's quest is more urgent!
Ok! Let's go! Who is that?
Itachi! I've arranged everything for you! Why are you coming back?
I'm back for one thing…
What is it? Sasuke!?
No, I'm looking for the 4th Hokage's legacy…
4th Hokage's legacy? Naruto? No way! Defeat me first!
Hey, kiddy! The 3rd hokage appoints you as the leader of support team. I'm your member now!
Great, Iruka sensei! With your help, we will surely finish the quest!
3rd hokage! I find the Recording Scroll!
You must have read the scroll!
Yes, I was curious…..
Then you must know the Konoha Riot 16 years ago and Naruto is the 4th Hokage's legacy.
Yes, Hokage!
Iruka sensei! The 3rd hokage orders us to help Kakashi's team 7!
Ok, I will go with you after I drive away the strange ninjas who scare off the kids!
Let me help you!
Hey, kiddy! The 3rd hokage appoints you as the leader of support team. I'm your member now! I'll be your $2cc1ff vanguard $  to resist all attacks!
Thank you, Iruka sensei! Then let's arrange $2cc1ff formations $!
What we just saw must be Sasuke's memory! So that is the killer of Uchiha Clan! Uchiha Itachi!
Right! Itachi was a genius! Somehow, he did such thing…..
Um?! What is that?!
This is?! The $2cc1ff S. Ability Scroll $ where Uchiha Clan records all ninjutsu!
Kiddy! You can't let others know you get that or you will be hunted by all ninjas!
Gotcha, Iruka sensei!

Humph, I have no connection with that guy! I'm looking for him! So you are $fb0735#playername#$  the 3rd Hokage mentioned!  Why did the hokage let a kiddy be my leader! Hey, I am a good weakness attacker! Let me be in the $2cc1ff assaulter $!
This guy is hot-tempered…
You watched the battle! That guy is way stronger than you! This is the $2cc1ff S. Ability Scroll $ that records all my ninjutsu. Take it and boost your power!
Iruka sensei, the S. Ability Scroll records a ninjutsu that can enter others' dream!
I've never heard of it! Let's have a try!
Ok. Sasuke is asleep! Let's try entering his dream!
Is this Sasuke's dream?!
$fb0735#playername#$, look!
Iruka sensei, where is this place!
It should be Death Forest. Chunin exam must have started.

Kiddy, how did you enter here? Since you are not able to come out alive, I will qualify you for the exam! Take this Heavenly Scroll! If you come out alive, come to $2cc1fffftavern$. I'm waiting for you!
Kiddy, you are lucky! Pass this chunin exam and you will become a chunin like me!
Really? I will try my best!
Now go to the guys of team 7. You will have better chance to win if you get together!
Sasuke! Don't lose to that guy!
I will.
Heehee…Uchiha Sasuke, let me feel your existence! You blood must be yummy!
Humph, cut the crap! I'm going to attack!
Gaara is defeated! Piece of rubbish! Not let's start the plan of destroying Konoha!
Kazekage, do you want to wage a war?
Humph! You are old and stupid, my dear Sarutobi sensei!
It's you! Orochimaru!
Kiddy, not bad! You mastered my channeling jutsu. Now raise your $2cc1ffSummoned Beast$!
Kill me! You've deprived me of the reason to exist.  Zabuza doesn't need useless ninja…
The person you value is that guy?

No one needs me in this world except Zabuza…Naruto, sorry, I can't die now! I will do the last thing for Zabuza! (Haku runs toward Zabuza who is fighting Kakashi while the 3rd person from the support team is running to the battlefield!)
Stand behind me. I will keep you safe!
Iruka sensei, I'm not the kiddy in the class. I'm the team leader now!
I know that you grow up!
Damn! That masked guy took away his body to save Zabuza. They are with him!  $fb0735#playername#$, Naruto, slow him down! I need to see through his Ninjutsu!
We will try our best, but be quick!
Uchiha Sasuke, to protect someone that is important to you, doesn't hesitate to come here even if you know it is a trap. You are respectable!
Is this your first time to see a friend die? Uchiha Sasuke, you are a respectable ninja!
Get off my back…..You will pay for it!
Zabuza the rank S ninja lives up to the reputation! …..The guy that hides over there, you can come out now!
Zabuza, your hand is crippled. You are not gonna win me! Then farewell…(Kakashi is about to stab Zabuza with a Kunai  )
How disappointing! You lost!
Gato! Why do you come here? What are your minions doing here?
I come here to kill you! Actually the guy called Haku is my enemy! (Gato angrily treads on Haku's body)
Gato! What are you doing?...Who are you? Are you to attack me? You are also with Gato?
You eyes can't catch up with my speed! (Haku comes to stab Naruto )
Cut the crap! Kill that geezer! Zabuza, come to me with his head! I'm off now….
Damn! These sound ninjas wrap themselves with Chakra Bags to boost their defense! $fb0735#playername#$, do you have any idea to $2cc1ffbreak the defense$?
I just learned a ninjutsu that should $2cc1ffbreak his defense$. Let's go!
Nature is calling. I have to go to the bathroom. Wait for me!
Wait, Naruto! What a nuisance! (Then Naruto comes out)
Naruto! Speak the cipher! Ninja song "Ninja's Chance"!
Let me think…..The best time to sneak in is when the enemies are in riot. The most important thing about being a ninja is to seize the moment!
You are not Naruto! Who the heck are you? (Sasuke throws the Kunai to the guy but he dodges it)
You are Anko?!
Iruka! How do you come here?
I don't know how we come. Since here is opened, the chunin exam must be started. Anko, are you the chief examiner?
Yes, here is the place for the 2nd chunin exam. Now get out of here!
Anko, could you let us attend the exam?
This is the qualification certificate for the 2nd exam: Heavenly Scroll. Take it! Now you need Earth Scroll to pass it. Moreover, you have to loot it from other teams!
Thanks, Anko!
If you are still alive, come to $2cc1fftavern$. I can $2cc1ffintroduce some memebers$to you. Now I have to go.
Orochimaru! I will take all your evil ninjutsu away!
Ah…..Stop!
Orochimaru! How stupid you are!
Damn geezer! Give me back my hands! How dare you seal my jutsu!
It's a shame that my soul energy is not powerful enough to die with you, but one day we will meet in another world….(The Sound Four takes away Orochimaru )
Fire flames wherever the tree leaves are dancing…..The shadow of fire will light the village and let the tree leaves sprout. Kiddy, the rest will be left to you...
The 3rd hokage!! Damn! I gotta tell everyone! Orochimaru, someday I will make you pay !
Gaara! Freeze there! (Sasuke is running after Gaara who Temari takes with in the chunin exam )
Temari, get out of my way…..
Ah……(Temari is pushed afar by Gaara)
Gaara, show me your true colors!
Uchiha Sasuke! To pursue the power, you have to hate! You are like me! Only by killing you can I feel I'm still alive! Come! Let me kill you! (Gaara charges at Sasuke with the arm of Shukaku)
Are you afraid of me…..Is this what you can do?
Damn! I can't move…(Then, Naruto and Sakura come to Sasuke)
Sasuke! Am I too late?
Naruto! What are you doing here? Run! He's a monster!
Sakura, take Sasuke and run!
(That eyesight)
What's wrong? Aren't you running way! (Sasuke and Sakura are captured by Gaara)
Damn…
What do they mean to you…….
They are my friends! If you dare to hurt them, I'll kill you.
Ah… (Gaara slowly grasps Sakura's hand)
What? Don't you want to kill me? Come on now!
Friends? Don't make me laugh! I only battle for myself. Come on! If you refuse to fight me, I will kill this girl!
Damn! I will fight. Now Naruto Uzumaki starts to release the secret Taijutsu!
My Chakra is exhausted….So do you! (The two are lying on the ground exhausted. Then Naruto crawls toward Gaara)
Stay back!
Somehow, I understand how you feel. It's painful to be alone……
But I find someone I care! I won't let you hurt them! I will stop you! (Nine-Tailed Demon Fox's pupilla slowly fills Naruto's eyes)
Why do you care about them…
Because they rescue me from the hell of loneliness and recognize my existence! They are my friends!
Enough, Naruto! Sakura is fine….
Great! (Naruto smiles)
Well... I  give it up….(Someday I will also find important friends)
The village is not ruined, but suffers a lot of damages! (Two mystery men are around the walls of Konoha Village)
What a pity! The village was so thriving……
It's not like you to be attached to the hometown!
….I am not attached to the hometown!
We didn't finish the quest last time we came here. This time, we shall make it!
Who knows……
Now let's have a drink!
You are not the villagers? What are you doing here? (Asuma and Kurenai stops the two mystery men who walk out of the tavern)
Long time no see….Asuma, Kurenai!
You know us? That means you are ninjas in the Konoha Village?!
(The two slowly take off the hats)
You are Uchiha Itachi!
Since you two know Itachi, allow me to introduce myself. My name is Kisame Hoshigaki. Nice to meet you!
Humph! You got away last time. This time I will kill you!
Asuma, Kurenai, leave! I don't want to kill you!
Don't jump the conclusion! (Kakashi suddenly shows up behind Kisame and Itachi with a Kunai at hand)
What are you doing here, Kakashi?
In this case, let's end this quickly……(Itachi closes the eyes and suddenly his eyes snap open)
Crap! Don't look at his eyes!
You are here to capture Naruto, don't you? I did the research. You work for Akatsuki! (Itachi and Kisame are shocked at what Kakashi says)
Kisame, take away Kakashi! For the rest of them, vanish them! (Kisame charges at Kakashi and the other people with the great blade Samehada)
Leaf tornado! (Gai suddenly blocks Kisame's attack )
Who is it?!
Konoha's sublime blue beast: Maito Gai!
What ridiculous outfits! You should be called rare beast!
Ow……(Kakashi falls to the ground)
Kisame, we are not coming to fight. Let's go! (The two leave)
Damn! $fb0735#playername#$, go to posthouse and tell Jiraiya that Itachi goes back to the village!
Gotcha, Gai sensei! (running toward the posthouse)
$fb0735#playername#$, what's the hurry? (You are stopped by Sasuke who is passing by)
I am to report to Jiraiya that Itachi is in the village!
Itachi! Uchiha Itachi!!! (Sasuke stands dumbfounded after hearing it)
I have to go! Catch you later!
Wait a second! I will go with you!
It's been a long time…..Sasuke! (The two arrive at the posthouse, only to find that Itachi and Kisame already get Naruto )
Damn! It's too late!
Uchiha Itachi……I am going to kill you!
I am hating you as you said…..I'm living to kill you! (Then Sasuke charges at Uchiha Itachi with Chidori)
Do you know why you are weak……'cause your hatred is not deep enough……(Itachi catches Sasuke with one hand)
Sasuke!
Stay out of this! Naruto, $fb0735#playername#$, this is my battle……
Kyuubi, no hurry! You will be the next. After all, you are our target!
Take Naruto away? Do you ask my permission? ((Jiraiya jumps in through the window behind Naruto)
Ninjutsu: Toad Mouth Trap! (To save Sasuke who is caught by Itachi, Jiraiya releases the Toad Mouth Trap)
Sad for you, Itachi, Kisame! I summoned the oesophagus of great toad in Mount Myōboku: Rock Lodging. Now I will make you two the great toad's foods!
What is that?!
$fb0735#playername#$, don't worry! This is my ninjutsu. Don't move!
Damn! (Kisame angrily swings the Samehada to attack meat walls that try to devour him)
Kisame! Follow me! (Itachi flees with Kisame in the other direction)
Humph, no one has got away from this ninjutsu so far!
Err?! (Suddenly Jiraiya runs toward Itachi)
What's wrong? Jiraiya sensei?
What is this black fire? It burns down the oesophagus of great toad in Mount Myōboku: Rock Lodging! (Jiraiya also comes to the end of the burned oesophagus and has to seal the black flame)
$fb0735#playername#$, Naruto, go training with me! And I can introduce you a gorgeous girl!
I am not going! I want to learn Chidori from Kakashi!
Really! I've got a ninjutsu that is way stronger than Chidori. In this case, I will take Sasuke!
Horny sage, I will go with you! Wait for me! I will go home and pack my luggage!
You don't have to take so much luggage! We are not to practice in some remote mountains….(After a while, Jiraiya signs, seeing Naruto's bulgy bag)
Jiraiya? What are you doing here?
(That girl is Tsunade horny sage said? Is she really 50 years old?!)
What do you want from me?
Well, let me get to the point then. Tsunade……the village wants you to be the 5th hokage right now!
Cough…….(Naruto is so shocked to hear this news that he is choked by the foods)
Who is this kid?
He is Uzumaki Naruto! Now tell me your decision!
Hokage is rubbish! Only a fool would want to be a Hokage!

Bastard! How dare you mock at the 3rd and 4th hokages in my presence!  (Naruto is collecting the Chakra to release the immature ninjutsu Jiraiya just taught and charging at Tsunade but is stopped by Jiraiya)
Humph! Let's make a bet! If you can acquire this ninjutsu in a week, I will be the hokage. Besides, I will give you the necklace left by the first hokage!
Naruto, agree to it! That necklace is invaluable!
Alright! I will acquire this ninjutsu and knock you down!
$fb0735#playername#$, I'm going to practice ninjutsu. Would you like to come with me?
Sure! I just need to get familiar with the ninjutsu on the S. Ability Scroll.
Tsunade! Long time no see! (Tsunade meets someone she shall not meet while Naruto is in the training)
Orochimaru……What are you doing here? Don't you fear that I'd kill you!
I know your weakness! I'm here to ask you for a favor, in return for which I will resurrect your lover and baby brother! How does it sound…..
……(Tsunade hesitates)
Ok, I will give you one week to consider and come over then!
(After a week……) Haha, I acquire this ninjutsu! Now I'm going to beat that old woman and grab the necklace!
……(Sasuke is right about him. He is an idiot indeed!)
Old woman!
Bastard! What did you call me? (Tsunade bursts into rage)
I have learnt this ninjutsu! Now give me the necklace!
(He really acquire it……)
Sorry to interrupt! (Orochimaru walks from the darkness)
Tsunade, have you made the decision?
……I won't cure your hands! You can leave now……
Humph! Then I will find another way to cure my hands and destroy Konoha Village! (Orochimaru leaves seeing Tsunade is determined)
Your name is Naruto, right? Now this necklace is yours! Take good care of it! (Tsunade takes off the necklace and gives it to Naruto after seeing Orochimaru leave)
Now you can call me the 5th hokage! Let's go back to the village and take your horny teacher with us! (Naruto goes back to the village with others but is challenged by Sasuke)
Who are you? (When Sasuke is wondering around the village, annoyed at Naruto's growth, he meets 4 ninjas sent by Orochimaru)
I am Kidomaru of Sound Four!
I am Jirobo!
I am Sakon!
I am Tayuya!
Humph! Orochimaru sent you! I'm not happy now. If you want to fight, I won't give you mercy!
Come on! I will break your ribs and play the beautiful melody!
Humph! I can't understand why Orochimaru wants him! (Sakon looks at Sasuke with the contempt after a battle)
It will only make you weak to stay in this rotten village and play this boring ninja game with those playmates! It won't get you stronger!
Go with us! Orochimaru will give you power!
……(Sasuke looks at them shocked)
Will you come with us or not? Think about it! We will wait for you outside the village! Don't forget your goal! (Sakon throws away Sasuke and leaves with the other three people)
Sasuke left the village last night! Presently we can only confirm that he is leaving for sound ninja! Go bring Sasuke back!
Gotcha! Kakashi sensei!
Sasuke! Finally I find you! Do you really go with these sound ninjas?
$fb0735#playername#$, what are you doing here! Go back! I've made up my mind!
Kill him! Or else our whereabouts will be exposed!
…I will kill you if you lay a finger on him! $fb0735#playername#$, go back! I will come back to the village when I kill Uchiha Itachi!
Let's go!
The sound ninja called Jirobo is straight ahead! Sorry, I didn't stop him!
It's alright! Leave him to me!
Choji, I've taken him out! Hang on! I will send you to Tsunade!
$fb0735#playername#$, it's no use. I've ate the chili pill! I am going to die……
Don't be silly! Tsunade's healing jutsu is the best in the world!
Neji! How come! (The No.1 Konoha Genin Hyuga Neji has his shoulders penetrated by the sound ninja )
Heehee! Another prey!
Bastard, go to hell!
Neji, hang on there! The medical team will soon arrive!
Cough……ok! You move on!
Shikamaru! How come……Sometimes, we also need brawn!
I miscalculated. My Chakra is used up! I'll leave the rest to you….
Rest assured! Get some rest first! I'll come back later!
They put Sasuke in a barrel and it is taken by a new sound ninja!
Ok! What about you? Are you alright?
I'm fine! I will get some rest first! Go find Naruto and bring Sasuke back!
Bastard! My Akamaru!
Kiba, better worry about yourself!
Brother, here comes another guy! Should we crush him to pieces?!
$fb0735#playername#$, be carful! He……Don't run so fast! I still have something to say!
This guy is hard to cope with! He is turning to 2 persons! Right! Kiba, what did you want to say to me?
Forget it!
Well, let's help Shikamaru then! Go!
No hurry! Just one moment……(Kimimaro puts his left arm bone aside when he speaks to Naruto )
This guy turns his bone into blade! And heals the wounds instantly!
This is not average bone. It's as hard as the steel!
So what? I will break it anyway!
It's just the beginning! You better not know what I can do!
I can't wait any more! (Suddenly the barrel where Sasuke is in cracks! Sasuke runs afar with a laugh)
Sasuke!
Better worry about yourself! (Kimimaro swings the bone blade and cleaves toward Naruto )
Leaf wind!! (Lee shows up and kicks Kimimaro away )
Who are you?
Thick eyebrows! Your body……
Naruto, forget about these! Go catch up Sasuke!
Naruto, leave this guy to us!
Thank you, guys! Let me bring back Sasuke first! (Naruto runs in the direction that Sasuke leaves)
He gets something! (Lee has been cornered! Then Gaara shows up!)
You are ……Gaara!
Leave it to me! I owe you Konoha a favor. Now let me return it!
We lost it!
No, this guy is defeated by his illness, but sometimes, luck is also a power……
You want to escape from me?! (Naruto is sad, faced with Sasuke who ignores him)
You this time……I told Sakura to leave me alone…..(Sasuke indifferently looks at Naruto)
Why……
I will no longer play that boring ninja games with you guys……
Why…Choji, Neji, Kiba, Shikamaru, Thick Eyebrow, and $fb0735#playername#$, everyone risks their lives to bring you back! What on earth do you take us as? (Naruto turns furious)
I will never grow strong with you! I want to stay with Orochimaru…

Orochimaru killed the third hokage and destroyed Konoha Village! Do you really think he will give you power for nothing! He wants your body as his container! You may also be killed! I won't watch you die!
I don't care only if I can achieve my goal! If you get in the way, I…
I won't let you. I will take you back at whatever cost!
Do you really want to kill me……(Naruto looks at Sasuke who charges at him in tears)
$fb0735#playername#$, stop……
Sasuke, why can't you understand Naruto!!
……Take Naruto back. I said that I would go back to the village after I killed Uchiha Itachi! (Sasuke runs away)
You are not dead! Great! Tsunade just asks me to take you back!
…(Kimimaro slowly lifts his arm and points at you)
Still want to fight? Alright……Better stun you!!
How strong of him!  He is wounded but still have such strength! If he could fight a bit longer, we might not finish the quest assigned by Tsunade!
Kakashi sensei, are you alright? Where is Gaara?

I'm fine! Gaara is taken by Akatsuki. I just fought against Deidara from Akatsuki. He is good at making explosive out of clay! Be careful! (Kakashi's left eye is closed. It seems that he just released a powerful Dōjutsu )
I will. Sensei, recover some Chakra first.
(Deidara has been corned and is unable to escape) Now let me show you the ultimate art! Blast!
Whoa!
Thanks god! It's not too late. (Kakashi transfers the blast to other space with Kamui). Is everyone alright?
We're fine, but Gaara is not here. He must be transferred to other place. We must catch him up!
Be careful of that guy ahead. He is Sasori from Akatsuki. To defeat him, you must destroy his Hiruko armor!
That puppet armor is poisonous. A slight bruise may get you killed. Do be careful! I recover some Chakra first.
Poisonous? Ok. Leave it to me!
(Hiruko armor is destroyed. A person comes out from it). You do have something. Now let me show you my best work-Third Kazekage puppet!
The third Kazekage? He who disappeared from Sand Country 10 years ago was made into a puppet!
This is not an average puppet. He inherits all the third kazekage's ninjutsu. Now die!
According to the information from Sand Country, Sasori is the only puppet maker who can create human puppets. Please be careful of the third Kazekage puppet.
Gotcha. I will do my best and defeat him!
When did he see through my ninjutsu? Never thought the third Kazekage would be defeated.
Other human puppets should also be useless. Seems like I have to battle with my own body! (Sasori turns his body into a creepy human puppet)
He made himself a puppet!
Unbelievable! We are going to have a rough time!
To defeat the puppet, you must destroy the emblem that generates Chakra, but the undead body is the hardest part. Seize the chance and break it!
This is Sasori's last battle. Are you ready?
